notes.en: [[character:norma]] relies on her Core Passive for both Daze and damage, so CRIT Rate matters. She has two W-Engine percentages: damage first, Daze second, relative to her signature at S1.
Target stats at level 60: ATK 2,400+, HP 9,500+, DEF 800+, CRIT Rate 80 to 100% and CRIT DMG 100%+.

[[character:sunna]] and Norma together make a very strong generic pair that any Attacker can slot in as a final pick. Between them they have enough buffs, Daze and personal damage to clear most endgame content.

[[character:pyrois]] and [[character:soldier-11]] both benefit significantly: Pyrois has one of the hardest-hitting Chain Attacks, and Norma meets Soldier 11's Additional Ability criteria and gives plenty of empowered Basics. [[character:cissia]] and [[character:orphie-magus]] can use her as a secondary DPS partner.

[[character:hugo]] gets a very good match from her Stun DMG Multiplier and duration extension, and her forced Chain Attack can give 3 Chains and a Totalize in the Hormone Punk window. For [[character:manato]] and [[character:starlight-billy]], her extra Chain Attack can be better than [[character:dialyn]] given their very long Ultimate animations.
The W-Engine ranking was calculated with [[character:pyrois]] (Sol Exuvia) and [[character:sunna]] (Thoughtbop) as teammates.
